guard/30875.htm.text: Guard Carlton: The swamp to the north of Aden Castle is called the Blazing Swamp. The name makes one think of some hellish sea of fire that is covered in molten rock or something... But looking at it from the outside, it really doesn't seem much different than any other marsh. However, the monsters…

guard/30875-1.htm.text: Guard Carlton: Well... There's tairim... It's like a bundle of fire that just floats around in the air... The undead called by the grand name of marsh judge...
